objective: Define one pure canonical upper-exclusive as-of boundary for raw insurance acquisition economics and durable outcome facts before aggregation.

semantics.effectiveAt: metadata only; never controls as-of inclusion
semantics.presentation: not filtered; current-state segmentation remains separate from historical evidence

rules: asOfExclusive must be a canonical UTC timestamp in ISO-8601 millisecond Z form.
Acquisition cost inclusion is controlled only by occurredAt.
Premium inclusion is controlled only by occurredAt; optional effectiveAt does not change inclusion.
Commission inclusion is controlled only by occurredAt.
Renewal inclusion is controlled only by occurredAt; optional effectiveAt does not change inclusion.
Durable quoted and bound outcome inclusion is controlled only by occurredAt.
Facts occurring exactly at asOfExclusive are excluded.
Facts before asOfExclusive are preserved without mutation and in original input order.
No grouping, aggregation, currency conversion, status inference, SQL, persistence access, or mutation occurs in this layer.
Filtering must happen before createInsuranceRelationshipAcquisitionAnalytics because attributed economics views no longer retain complete raw fact-time evidence.
explicitlyDeferred: as-of combined created-at acquisition performance snapshot
